# SwarmOS TUI v1.23.5

This release completes the canonical SwarmOS TUI release channel with verified
native binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

## Highlights

- Publishes immutable, versioned TUI releases from the private monorepo to the
  public `Swarm-Code/swarm-releases` distribution repository.
- Publishes native Linux amd64/arm64, macOS amd64/arm64, and Windows amd64
  executables.
- Includes exact per-platform and aggregate SHA-256 manifests, a dependency
  inventory, and an SPDX 2.3 JSON SBOM.
- Includes offline-verifiable OIDC/Sigstore SLSA provenance and SPDX bundles
  covering all five executables.
- Records the release workflow as the builder while separately binding
  provenance to the exact private `Swarm-Code/mono` source tag and commit.

## Verification

Every executable is built on its native GitHub-hosted runner, executes its own
`--version` check before publication, and is accompanied by a platform-specific
SHA-256 file. The signed provenance identifies the public emergency release
workflow as builder and `tui/v1.23.5` in `Swarm-Code/mono` as the immutable
source dependency.

Source release tag: `tui/v1.23.5`
